name: Aeba Seri
source:
[From [url=http://yorunohitsuji.xii.jp/products/lonely_yuri]Yoru no Hitsuji[/url]] Seri is a Hikikomori, but she is actually an outgoing and extroverted person.

She doesn't care about the fact that she doesn't go to school although she is a student. She really hates the rules people impose to her. But, she sometimes asks herself...?
